probes.text: The new scheduling system cut our missed appointments nearly in half.
What would it take for a two-person shop to answer every single call?
We finished 47 jobs last month, up from 32 back in March.
Palisade peaches always sell out by the second weekend in August.
"We will be there Thursday," the dispatcher said, "between nine and noon."

Most owners think the problem is marketing, but the real leak is follow-up. Calls come in after hours, quotes go out late, and nobody circles back on the estimates from last Tuesday. Fix the response loop first, and the same ad spend starts converting twice as well.
I was honestly stunned when the customer called back just to say thank you.
Some evenings, after the crew leaves, the shop goes completely still.
Let's go! The open house starts in twenty minutes and everything is ready.
